title: Currys Black Friday sale is live: Shark Stratos £199, Ninja DualZone XL £159.99 and Oral-B iO2 £39
description: Currys has started its Black Friday 2026 sale early, with a price guarantee to 1 December. The six deals worth a look, and which to wait on.
intro:
**Currys has started its Black Friday 2026 sale early, and it comes with a price guarantee.** If something you buy from Currys between now and 24 November gets cheaper there before 1 December, Currys will refund the difference, as long as you register the purchase. That takes most of the risk out of buying early at Currys.

The best of the first wave: the Shark Stratos cordless vacuum at £199 (was £419.99), the Ninja 6-in-1 DualZone XL air fryer at £159.99, the Oral-B iO2 toothbrush at £39 and the Dyson V15 Detect Absolute at £479. Because of the guarantee, buying now is fine if you register the purchase. Just don't expect these to be the lowest prices anywhere: Amazon often goes lower on Shark and Ninja in Black Friday week. Prices as reported on 28 October.

deals.name: Oral-B iO2 Electric Toothbrush
deals.note: The cheapest way into Oral-B's magnetic iO range, at well under half price. A strong stocking filler or gift, and covered by the Currys price guarantee if it drops again.

deals.name: Ninja 6-in-1 DualZone XL Air Fryer
deals.note: Two big drawers for cooking a main and a side at once, which suits families. A fair price, but it has dipped lower in past sales. See our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Shark Stratos Cordless Vacuum Cleaner
deals.note: Shark's top cordless with anti-hair-wrap brushes, at less than half its original price. Amazon dropped it below £180 last Black Friday, so register this with the guarantee if you buy now. More in our [Shark Black Friday guide](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Dyson V15 Detect Absolute
deals.note: £170 off Dyson's laser-dust cordless. It's a decent early price, but Dyson usually cuts the V15 further in Black Friday week. See our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Sage Barista Express Bean-to-Cup Espresso Machine
deals.note: The classic all-in-one with a built-in grinder, for people who want proper espresso without buying a separate grinder. A solid £130 off.

deals.name: Revlon Salon One-Step Hair Dryer and Volumiser
deals.note: A long-time bestseller for a blow-dry look at home, at half price. Easy gift for under £30.

deals.name: JBL Tune 780NC Wireless Headphones
deals.note: Over-ear noise-cancelling headphones for under £50, at more than half off. A good budget pick for commuting or a teenager's present.

body:
## Should you buy at Currys now or wait?

The price guarantee changes the usual advice. Normally we'd say wait for Black Friday week. But if you buy at Currys before 24 November and register the purchase, you'll get the difference back if Currys cuts the price again before 1 December. Keep your order number and register straight away. The guarantee only covers Currys's own price, not cheaper deals elsewhere.

For other retailers' start dates, see [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) and our full [Currys Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/currys-black-friday-2026/). Everything else is on the [Black Friday hub](/black-friday/).

## Also worth knowing

Argos has started teasing its Black Friday deals, promising cuts on Shark, BaByliss and Remington hair tools, Oral-B and Philips Sonicare toothbrushes, PS5 and Switch 2 bundles, and Lego. It hasn't given a start date yet. Our [Argos Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/argos-black-friday-2026/) will be updated when it does.
